duplicate_policy.limitation: Exact normalized text filtering does not detect semantic/phrase overlap or pretraining contamination
duplicate_policy.normalization: Unicode NFKC, casefold, collapse whitespace; no punctuation or HTML changes
duplicate_policy.within_split: retain all natural duplicates, including final test; report counts

source.license: apache-2.0 per dataset card; review original data terms
source.notes: Official train/test split; unsupervised split unused. Long texts require a common declared input truncation policy when comparing LLMs.

text_policy.applies_to: all splits and all model families

training.latency_measurement: amortized batch; not individual request latency
